content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited has issued for recruitment of 41 Executives in various disciplines. Official Recruitment Website: CPCL Careers and Recruitment Information Short Notification PDF: Download Here .

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Vacancy 2026 - 41 Posts
content_sections.text: CPCL has announced 41 Executive vacancies across engineering, information systems, official language and secretarial disciplines. Engineer (Chemical) accounts for the highest number of vacancies, with 22 posts. Vacancy Clarification: The Manager (Secretarial) and Senior Manager (Secretarial) designations are grouped under Post Code CPCL 08 with a combined allocation of one vacancy. They should not be counted as two separate openings. The advertised vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease according to management decisions, reservation rules and applicable Government guidelines. Of the 41 advertised Executive posts, 37 vacancies are for engineering positions across five disciplines.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Important: The post names indicate the relevant disciplines, but the short notice does not confirm which degrees, specializations or equivalent qualifications will be accepted. Candidates should not assume that every degree in a related field is automatically eligible. Applicants interested in the Manager and Senior Manager (Secretarial) positions should particularly check the detailed notification for any professional qualification and experience requirements.
